7879e41ea1a06c14df023f18f89a0116.description: UUIDv7 vs UUIDv4 for database indexing - Programming Language

files.content:
+-------------------------+---------+------------------------------+-------------------+
| Language                | Support | Implementation               | Minimum Version   |
+-------------------------+---------+------------------------------+-------------------+
| JavaScript / TypeScript | Library | uuid (v7())                  | Package-dependent |
| JavaScript Web Crypto   | Partial | crypto.randomUUID() (v4)     | No native v7      |
| Bun                     | Native  | Bun.randomUUIDv7()           | Version-dependent |
| Python                  | Native  | uuid.uuid7()                 | 3.14              |
| Go                      | Library | google/uuid (NewV7())        | Package-dependent |
| Rust                    | Library | uuid (Uuid::now_v7())        | Package-dependent |
| Java                    | Native  | UUID.ofEpochMillis()         | JDK 26            |
| C# / .NET               | Native  | Guid.CreateVersion7()        | .NET 9            |
| PHP                     | Library | ramsey/uuid (Uuid::uuid7())  | Package-dependent |
| Ruby                    | Library | UUID generation gem          | Package-dependent |
| Swift                   | Library | External UUID library        | Package-dependent |
| Kotlin                  | Library | UUID library                 | Package-dependent |
+-------------------------+---------+------------------------------+-------------------+

+------------------------+----------------------+----------------------+
| Database               | UUIDv7 Storage       | Native Generation    |
+------------------------+----------------------+----------------------+
| PostgreSQL 18+         | UUID                 | uuidv7()             |
| MySQL                  | BINARY(16) / CHAR(36)| No                   |
| MariaDB 11.7+          | UUID                 | UUID_v7()            |
| SQL Server             | UNIQUEIDENTIFIER     | No                   |
| SQLite                 | BLOB / TEXT          | No                   |
| MongoDB                | Binary UUID          | No                   |
| CockroachDB            | UUID                 | Version-dependent    |
| Oracle Database 26ai   | RAW(16)              | No                   |
| Redis                  | String               | No                   |
+------------------------+----------------------+----------------------+

+----------------------+---------+----------------------------------------------+
| ORM / Framework      | Support | Implementation                               |
+----------------------+---------+----------------------------------------------+
| Prisma               | Library | @default(uuid(7))                            |
| Drizzle ORM          | Library | SQL uuidv7() or application generator        |
| TypeORM              | Library | External UUID generator                      |
| Sequelize            | Library | Application-side generation                  |
| MikroORM             | Library | Custom UUID generator                        |
| SQLAlchemy           | Library | Python uuid.uuid7()                          |
| Entity Framework Core| Native  | .NET 9 Guid.CreateVersion7()                 |
| GORM                 | Library | UUID package                                 |
+----------------------+---------+----------------------------------------------+
